subject: CedarPoint SIG intake — pre-call coordination & evidence gap log
messages:
From: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@cedarpoint.com>

Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, security@cedarpoint.com
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: SIG + CAIQ intake — scheduling and preliminary Qs

Hi Ben / team,

Thanks for taking this on. We're starting a SIG + CAIQ intake for our evaluation of Redwood for platform-wide conversational features. Would like to set a short intake call (30–45m) to walk through the questionnaire, agree scope, and identify evidence owners.

A few quick items for the agenda so you can prep:
- Confirm scope (hosting model: Redwood Hosted API, dedicated pool for POC)
- CAIQ baseline answers we expect and any tailored responses
- Evidence we will need (SOC 2 report, encryption diagrams, network architecture, audit logs)
- Who at CedarPoint will own evidence pulls (security@cedarpoint.com)

Proposed times (ET):
- Tue Nov 3, 10:00–10:45 ET
- Tue Nov 3, 14:00–14:45 ET

I've attached our internal prep doc with high-level questions (CedarPoint_SIG_Prep_Questions.docx).

Can you confirm availability and whom from Redwood will join?

Thanks,
Alex Jensen
Security Program Manager
CedarPoint Amusements

Attachment: CedarPoint_SIG_Prep_Questions.docx (docx, 68KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@cedarpoint.com>
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG + CAIQ intake — scheduling and preliminary Qs

On Mon, Nov 2, 2026 at 9:15 AM Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@cedarpoint.com> wrote:
> Thanks for taking this on. We're starting a SIG + CAIQ intake for our evaluation of Redwood...

Alex — thanks for the note and the prep doc. We can absolutely run a focused intake call and come with a first-pass CAIQ / evidence map.

Availability: Tue Nov 3 at 14:00 ET works for our team. We'll plan for 40 minutes. I'll invite a short follow-up working session if we uncover many open evidence items.

Attendees from Redwood (proposed):
- Ben Carter (me) — security/compliance lead for the account
- Hannah Schmitt — evidence & SOC2 owner

Quick pre-call asks so we make the 40m efficient:
- Please confirm whether the POC will run on Redwood Hosted API or Dedicated capacity (you mentioned both; if you pick Dedicated we need the initial capacity & region).
- If CedarPoint requires a specific data residency region, list it now (us-east-1 / eu-west-1 / etc).
- If you expect the SOC2 report to cover ingestion/processing for the POC dataset, tell us scope (entire org vs. scoped project).

Preliminary evidence gaps we see (we'll validate on the call):
- Tokenization/PII handling diagram (we need a short architecture diagram showing how tokens are captured/filtered)
- Retention policy export for logs (last 90/180/365 days?)
- Proof of key management for encryption at rest (KMS/HSM config)
- Third-party penetration test results (most customers provide summary)

I've attached our intake template so you can pre-fill where possible: redwood-sig-intake-template.xlsx

I'll send a calendar invite for Tue 14:00 ET and include a short agenda.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-sig-intake-template.xlsx (xlsx, 24KB)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800

Thanks Alex — adding a short agenda and suggested owners so the call can be action-oriented: 

Agenda (30–40m):
1) Introductions & scope confirmation (5m) — Alex + Ben
2) CAIQ structure & any CedarPoint-specific tailoring (10m) — Ben
3) Evidence map review — call out which items CedarPoint owns vs Redwood provides (15m)
4) Next steps: upload/hand-off schedule (5m)

Suggested evidence owner mapping (preliminary):
- SOC2 report & SOC2 scope confirmation — CedarPoint to state required scope; Redwood will provide our latest report (Hannah)
- Network diagram & tokenization flow — Redwood will provide architecture diagram (Ben/Hannah)
- Audit logs & log retention export — Redwood to provide example extracts and retention policy (Hannah)
- KMS/HSM configuration proof — Redwood to provide KMS model description and certificate references (Ben)

Optional ask: if CedarPoint can pre-populate any CAIQ cells that are obvious for your environment (e.g., hosted vs dedicated), that will save time.

I'll consolidate notes during the call and produce an action log with owners & deadlines. Happy to field any pre-call evidence attachments — please upload to the Drive link in the calendar invite.

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

(On a practical note: tokenization diagram is especially important for your procurement team; if you can surface a brief sketch before the call we'll annotate it live.)
